Follow this 5 step plan.

1. Read the GitHub issue, comment and comment history.
2. Address the issue. Do not add any comments. Reserve mod.rs, lib.rs and main.rs file for use/mod statements, put any other code into an appropriately named file. Ensure that files are a reasonable size, eg. between 100-200 lines. Put all test code into a tests file, either named as tests.rs or use a "_tests.rs" suffix. Do not use any floating functions, put all functions into an impl.
3. Run `git fetch origin master` then `git rebase origin/master` and fix any merge errors. If you cannot rebase (e.g. you are not on a branch with `origin/master` available), skip this step.
4. Run the formatter and linter appropriate for this project and fix any issues that arise (for Rust projects run `cargo fmt` and `cargo clippy`). If the project has no formatter or linter, skip this step.
5. Output a concise high level summary of your actions that can be used in a pull request.
